ai_summary: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited's material subsidiary, Aeroflex Neu Limited, has approved the acquisition of a 55% stake in Aerolex Cables Private Limited for ₹3100 lakhs, marking its entry into the wire and cable manufacturing and exporting business. This strategic move aims to diversify product offerings and strengthen its position within the AI Infra and Data Centre sector, with future tranches of acquisition also planned. However, the announcement lacks crucial financial details regarding Aerolex Cables, making it difficult to fully assess the acquisition's valuation and potential financial impact.
